source: can you make me a slip and slide game were the longer you slide the more points you get and you can buy pets to help you speed multiplier and there a treadmills to train your speed and make it 1m studs is the end of the track then you go back to the start of the slip and slide and get 1 lap on your character that is on the top of the screen to show your progress and make furthest stud leader board,most money leader board and most playtime leader board with a popular thumbnail of a bacon sliding on a slip in slide covered in soap with rainbow text saying 999m studs

answers.ask: Is one million studs literal? At walk speed that is over seventeen hours of track - should it be a repeating segment instead?
answers.answer: Make it a repeating segmented track with progress measured up to 1,000,000 studs, so it stays playable while still showing the 1m-stud goal.

answers.ask: What does the slide sit in - a water park, a grass field, a neon void?
answers.answer: Set the slip and slide in a bright cartoon water park with grass around it, soap, and colorful rainbow visuals.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D slip-and-slide map in a bright cartoon water park, with a long repeating segmented slide track that represents progress up to 1,000,000 studs. The slide begins at a clear start area and runs through grassy park surroundings with soap-covered surfaces and colorful rainbow visuals, looping seamlessly so riders can return to the start after reaching the end goal. Include treadmill training areas near the start, and leave space for physical leaderboard displays for furthest distance, most money, and most playtime.
blob:
## Genre
The dominant genre is Simulation because distance raises score and trained speed drives persistent progression. Racing is secondary because the slide has a measured lap and terminal goal.

## Shape and preset
Use `route-circuit`, taken from outside Simulation’s usual shape set, as a seamless repeating slide loop whose accumulated traversal represents 1,000,000 studs. No preset remains honest: Stat Grinder supplies the training station but not this circuit, while Circuit Racing does not describe the progression loop.

## Config requirements
Use `station-training` for treadmill banks near the start, visually dense enough for several players to train. Use `startpoint-line` for the clearly marked launch point and `trigger-finish` for the rainbow end-goal structure. Add three physical leaderboard display walls—furthest distance, most money, and most playtime—as scene-specific image geometry with no canonical option ID.

## Layout requirements
The layout half of `station-training` places treadmill activation regions on each treadmill near the start. The layout halves of `startpoint-line` and `trigger-finish` place one launch marker and one terminal detector at the 1,000,000-stud represented goal. Place one `trigger-lap` at the seamless return seam to increment the visible lap count. Reserve one display surface for each of the three requested leaderboards.

## Layout components
Build a broad soap-coated slip-and-slide as reusable segments forming one clean closed route through grassy water-park scenery. A start plaza holds treadmill rows and three leaderboard walls without narrowing the slide entrance. Rainbow arches and distance markers communicate progress toward 1,000,000 studs; the final gateway returns riders cleanly to the start. Keep the loop readable in plan and compose the start plaza as the foreground anchor.

## Render order
Render `authored_plan` first because this is a racing circuit and its loop must close without broken or ambiguous joins.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is huge in represented distance, though modular repetition keeps the physical build manageable. The theme is bright cartoon water park with grass, soap, and rainbow accents. Use `P6` because circuit closure and segment continuity must be valid by construction.
